dedupe_keys.name: dataset of flexible process plans for representative parts produced within manufacturing system affected by cyber attacks

description: Katarina Brenjo and Milica Petrovic publish technical data for alternative manufacturing process plans. The description identifies representative parts, their geometric and functional features, machine tools, cutting tools, access directions and operation times. These define alternative ways of producing a part when resources become unavailable, including disruption from cyberattacks. Zenodo lists fifteen job-specific PDF files and an additional machine-and-tool document, free under CC BY 4.0. The March 2025 release contains engineering inputs, not a historical factory time series; the physical site and temporal resolution are unspecified. The supplied metadata use the language code ang, which appears inconsistent with the English title and description; this draft records only the observed English metadata. The technical sheets were not downloaded. They can support process-planning simulations, while no related catalogue benchmark is explicitly identified.
